title: 第1613章 五个第1612章 六十分
content_zh:
第1613章五个
大鹅感受到二狗子的愤怒情绪，用尽全力往东北方向飞去。
沿途，每过一会，墨羽就给二狗子通报一次方向与距离。
双方的距离，在渐渐拉近。
终于，他看到了前方，有一行五人，正在不疾不徐地飞行。
对方此时已经发现身后追来的大白鹅和二狗子，他们反而不走了，停在原地，一脸戏谑地看着追来的二狗子。
“两个合体期的人头，价值二十分！”
“那只大白鹅算不算积分？”
“无妨，如果大白鹅不算积分，咱们就把它炖了，也能饱餐一顿……”
这五个人，你一言我一语，已经在讨论斩杀二狗子之后的事了。
随着双方距离靠近，二狗子悄悄地冲蛛儿使了个眼色。
蛛儿会意，已经从鹅背上飞走了，离得远远的。
对面那五人，此刻已经祭出飞剑，同时向一人一鹅斩来。
大鹅见此，毫无惧意，反而有些兴奋，它鸣叫一声，双翅一振，迎着对面的飞剑加速冲去。
对于他这种送死的打法，二狗子早就习以为常，他早已将背后的重剑抽出，握在手里。
当大鹅刚要和两柄飞剑撞到一起时，二狗子手中重剑带着一股强大威能斩出。
“轰轰……”
两声巨响，那两柄飞剑已经被他劈得倒飞回去。
正前方那两名仙君府弟子，看到自己的飞剑被一股巨力劈飞，略微有些惊讶。
没想到，混乱之地的蝼蚁，竟然还有这等实力。

不过那又如何，在他们五人的围攻下，必死无疑。
与此同时，剩下的三柄飞剑已经从不同方向，往二狗子斩来。
大鹅身体猛地再次加速，将剩下的三柄飞剑全都避开了。
那三柄飞剑扑了个空，在空中一个掉头，继续往二狗子背后追来。
二狗子神识纵观全场，前面有两名修士挡路，很快就能够着了。
身后三柄飞剑，其中一柄斩向大鹅的屁股，还有两柄剑，是刺向二狗子的后背。
二狗子心一横，决定硬接身后的三剑，抓住机会，弄死前面两个再说。
当即，他手中巨剑化为一百丈长，同时一拍大鹅的脖子，示意他加速向前。
大鹅也是个不怕死的，他也发现了刺向身后的三剑，此时也不管不顾，加速向前冲。
身后的三柄飞剑，眨眼间已经追上来了。
三声巨响，其中两剑，斩在二狗子的背上。
他的身上浮现出一层金色的甲胄，成功帮他挡住了这两剑。
content_en:
Chapter 1613 Five
The big goose felt Ergouzi's anger and flew to the northeast with all its strength.
Along the way, Mo Yu informed Er Gouzi of the direction and distance every once in a while.
The distance between the two sides is gradually getting closer.
Finally, he saw a group of five people flying slowly ahead.
At this time, the other party had already noticed the big white goose and Er Gouzi chasing behind them. Instead, they stopped walking and looked at the chasing Er Gouzi with a playful look on their faces.
"Two heads in the combined stage are worth twenty cents!"
“Does that big white goose count as points?”
"It doesn't matter. If the big white goose doesn't count, we can stew it and have a full meal..."
These five people, talking to each other, are already discussing what will happen after Ergouzi is killed.
As the distance between the two parties approached, Ergouzi quietly winked at Zhuer.
The spider understood and flew away from the goose's back, far away.
The five people on the opposite side had already launched their flying swords, attacking one person and one goose at the same time.
Seeing this, the big goose showed no fear, but was a little excited. It chirped, flapped its wings, and rushed towards the flying sword on the opposite side.
Ergouzi had long been accustomed to his death-defying fighting style. He had already drawn out the heavy sword from his back and held it in his hand.
Just when the big goose was about to collide with the two flying swords, the heavy sword in Ergouzi's hand slashed out with a powerful force.
"Boom boom..."
With two loud noises, the two flying swords were knocked back by him.
The two Immortal Lord Mansion disciples in front were slightly surprised when they saw their flying swords being blown away by a huge force.
Unexpectedly, the ants in the chaotic land actually have such strength.
But so what, under the siege of the five of them, death is inevitable.
At the same time, the remaining three flying swords were already slashing at Ergouzi from different directions.
The big goose's body suddenly accelerated again, avoiding all the remaining three flying swords.
The three flying swords flew into the air, turned around in the air, and continued to chase after Er Gouzi.
Ergouzi looked at the entire scene with his spiritual consciousness. There were two monks in front of him blocking the way, and he was able to hit them quickly.
There were three flying swords behind him, one of which was aimed at the big goose's butt, and the other two swords were aimed at Er Gouzi's back.
Ergouzi was heartbroken, and decided to catch the three swords behind him, seize the opportunity, and kill the two in front before going on.
Immediately, the giant sword in his hand became a hundred feet long, and at the same time he patted the goose's neck, signaling him to speed forward.
The big goose is also not afraid of death. He also discovered the three swords stabbing behind him. At this time, he ignored them and accelerated forward.
The three flying swords behind him had caught up in the blink of an eye.
There were three loud noises, and two of the swords struck Er Gouzi on the back.
A layer of golden armor appeared on his body, successfully blocking the two swords for him.
